description: Wallet and wallet SDK for the Logos Execution Zone (LEZ): QML SDK for Basecamp apps, TypeScript client and codec, LWS-0 protocol.
rules: Basecamp apps reach the wallet through kit.api from the vendored LogosKit/ folder; never hold keys in an app.
A proposal resolves when the user approves it with a handle; follow it with watchTransaction.
Check kit.sdk.isUserRejection(e) and show nothing for a user's refusal.
List every intent the app uses in metadata.json uses, as objects.
